lines.en: : Hey, Yasu. What are you up to tonight?
: Basking in the warmth of the second dorm floor, absorbing the vibrations that crawl up the sides of the building and-
: That's nice. Do you want to hang out for a little while?
: Do you have a moment to hear about our lord and savior?
: I have a moment to hear about other things. Not really that, though.
: How sad. What better night than tonight to be saved?
I do not wind up being saved, but I do wind up killing time with Yasu in the hall.
Or, I'm sorry- Time winds up moving onto the second plane of existence because death is not real.
Regardless, the two of us make idle chit chat that scares Kirin back into her room and, before long, Yasu and I part ways.
I head home just as confused as I always am after talking to her.
